findings.name: Venusian
findings.evidence_quote: Music. In The Groove 2. Also lists Arkanoid, Virtua Fighter 4 among arcade cabs at Venusian Cocktail & Gelateria, Rimini.
findings.note: ITG2 is a pad rhythm game not in the slug list; mapped as other. ZIv notes also list In the Groove 2. No confirmation of modern maimai/DDR A cabinet. Currency of insert-coin list unclear.

findings.name: VAMS MUSIC/SPORT
findings.evidence_quote: Shard address text is Busan BIFF square but notes say country corrected from coordinates (South Korea -> Japan); lat/lng ~33.18,131.08 is Oita-area Japan, not Busan.
findings.note: Identity/location too ambiguous to attach any game list. No web footprint for VAMS MUSIC/SPORT at either Busan BIFF or Oita coords. Do not invent lineup.

findings.name: Dream Planet Imaike (ドリームプラネット今池店)
findings.evidence_quote: IIDXについてのお知らせ ライトニングモデル含め全台を撤去する事になりました。撤去時期は10月末を予定 (2023).
findings.note: Historically had IIDX (up to 6) and SDVX per kamihate 2022 list. All IIDX removed ~2023-10. Current X profile describes crane/SDBH/Ganba Legends/mahjong; ZIv notes are kids card games only. No positive 2025-2026 confirmation of remaining rhythm cabs or of zero rhythm: unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.name: SOYU GAME FIELD Noshiro (ソユーゲームフィールド能代店)
findings.evidence_quote: SOYU official shop page for AEON TOWN Noshiro location; no public machine lineup of rhythm games found.
findings.note: Other SOYU GAME FIELD shops in Hokkaido often carry taiko on taiko wiki, but Noshiro (Akita) has no confirmed placement hit. No game list invented.

findings.name: SOYU Play Land Sopia ITOKU Across Noshiro ソユープレイランドソピアいとくアクロス能代店
findings.evidence_quote: Official SOYU Play Land Sopia ITOKU Across Noshiro page; hours/address only, no rhythm cab inventory published.
findings.note: No taiko/maimai locator or player report found for this Noshiro branch.

findings.name: PALO Goshogawara (PALO五所川原店)
findings.evidence_quote: Fantasy PALO Goshogawara shop list page (Across Plaza); chain often has family/arcade mix but this store has no published rhythm list.
findings.note: PALO Abashiri/Ebetsu/etc. appear on Hokkaido taiko wiki; Goshogawara (Aomori) not found on regional otoge lists.

findings.name: Back to the arcade
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv/shard cab notes: Initial D Arcade Stage 3; R-Tuned; Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE 2/3/3DX+ only (racing specialty).
findings.note: No positive statement that zero rhythm games exist; listed cabs are all racing. No independent 2024+ lineup. unknown not confirmed_none.

findings.note: Music category retained after crane oasis rebrand; taiko still reported. maimai removed at rebrand. Specific other music titles not confirmed post-2026-07.

findings.evidence_quote: Official bowling center site; no published arcade rhythm machine list found for Tokiwadaira.

findings.note: jubeat listed on w.atwiki.jp/jubeat Fukuoka page for Canal City Taito. No current maimai claim in this research pass.

findings.name: Bowling Kingdom Sport Taira (ボウリング王国スポルト平店)

findings.name: Hapipi Land Fukushima (ハピピランド福島店)
findings.evidence_quote: 人気の太鼓の達人やプリクラ、アーケードゲームがたくさんあります! (Hapipi Land Don Quijote Fukushima photo caption).
findings.note: Kids/family arcade in Donki Fukushima 4F; taiko presence claimed. No count. Other major SEGA/KONAMI music titles not evidenced.

findings.name: THE 3RD PLANET Pivot Fukushima (THE 3RD PLANET ピボット福島店)
findings.evidence_quote: 設置音ゲーリスト(2022年2月23日最終確認): 新太鼓の達人:3 / maimaiでらっくす:2 / チュウニズムPARADISE LOST:1 + 白筐体:1 / WACCA noted in tips.
findings.note: Store rebranded to サープラ福島あそびタウン (2024-03). Yahoo review 2022: 音ゲーもありますよ. 2022 list is old; titles may have changed after rebrand. Counts from 2022 only; mark unverified.

findings.name: Water Park Game Center (ウォーターパーク ゲームセンター)
findings.evidence_quote: 人気の景品が勢ぞろいするクレーンゲームコーナー ... 30台以上のクレーンゲーム. Official describes only crane prize corner; no music/rhythm machines advertised.
findings.note: Old ~2017 YouTube of waterpark arcade showed taiko historically; current official gamecorner is crane-only. Positive description of crane-only product line supports confirmed_none for rhythm today.

findings.name: Yabuzuka Batting Center (薮塚バッティングセンター)

findings.name: BIGBANG Kitami (BIGBANG北見店)
findings.evidence_quote: BIG BANG 北見店（リニューアル予定） 台数1台 ニジイロ 200円/3曲 最終確認2025/5/29. 補足: 音ゲーは多めらしい. 4thTRAX 2026/7/26: IIDX 32 Pinky Crush が撤去.

findings.name: Fantasy Kids Resort Shin-Sapporo (ファンタジーキッズリゾート新さっぽろ店)

findings.note: Indoor kids park free-play arcade includes taiko. Not a standard pay-per-credit music corner. Generation/count unclear. Separate from Molly Fantasy Shin-Sapporo.

findings.name: GiGO SEIYU Teine (GiGO西友手稲)
findings.evidence_quote: IIDX[LM]2 SDVX[VM]3 GITADORA GF/DM各1 pop'n2 ポラリスコード2 maimaiでらっくす2 CHUNITHM金1銀3 オンゲキ2 太鼓2. 備考: 2023/12 ディノスパーク→GiGO西友手稲; 2024/9 西友→イオン運営移管で現屋号. Official gigo.co.jp/shops/a-sapporo-teine lists maimai / SDVX / IIDX and 音楽ゲーム.
findings.note: Same physical store as GiGO AEON Sapporo Teine SC (rebrand). Counts from 2024-04 DDR-Navi; taiko wiki lists 2 cabs but with older final confirm on one path. gitadora count 2 = GF+DM. Re-verify after AEON rename.
